description: Encode and decode text in Base64, Base64URL, Base32, Base58, Base85 and hex. Operations: "encode" — Encode text into the chosen format.; "decode" — Decode text from the chosen format back to plain text.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: encode: The plain text to encode. decode: The encoded text to decode.

operation.description: encode — Encode text into the chosen format. decode — Decode text from the chosen format back to plain text.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

format.description: encode: Target encoding format. decode: Source encoding format. Used by: encode, decode.

name: base64
title: Base64 Encoder & Decoder
